params.caption: 🕹️ Xbox turns 25 — and its CEO's message sparks AI talk For the Xbox 25th anniversary, CEO Asha Sharma shared her view of gaming's next 25 years. She said the cost, resources and risk of making games have grown so much that "too many ideas never become games" — and many fans read the message as a push for AI. 🕒 Nov 12, 2026 · 20:11 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: GameSpot 👥 @Xbox 🤖 AI in game dev: yes or no? React 👍/👎 and comment 💬 #Xbox #Xbox25 #Microsoft #GamingNews
